audit: Independent scratch audit, frozen before generating controls or scoring K4
update: Move emitted/observed ciphertext symbol to front; preserve all other relative order
start: Canonical index zero, no separator or resets
acceptance: All 24 fixed known plaintext positions match; exact 97-letter regeneration must also pass
filler: Each character is AZ[int(sha256(seed|model|replicate|position),big) mod 26], then overwrite literal crib strings at exact positions. Constraint-conditioned synthetic text, not natural prose.
positive_design: Eight fixed synthetic plaintexts per each of four models, encrypted with direct mutable-list generator
nearby_negative_design: Same 32 literal-crib plaintexts encrypted with emitted-symbol move-to-back instead of move-to-front, same R and S0
histogram_decoy_design: Four seeded random.Random shuffles per positive ciphertext, preserving each exact ciphertext histogram. Selector receives the same 24 literal crib constraints for every control.
blindness: Algorithmic label blinding: selector process sees only opaque ID and ciphertext, all labels/plaintexts remain in a separate truth file until predictions are written. This is not investigator blinding.
independent_recovery: Decoder derives each state directly from ciphertext prefix: previously seen symbols in descending last-occurrence order, followed by never-seen symbols in initial-alphabet order. It does not call or share move-to-front/inverse code.
control_checks: True model included and full planted 97-letter plaintext recovered in all 32 positives
Report unique correct, ambiguous, wrong unique and omitted truth separately
Report all nearby-negative and decoy acceptances without tuning
All 26 plaintext and ciphertext one-step cases per model
Exhaustive all messages of lengths zero through three per model
Independent forward and backward full-message checks, all permutation states and stable nonselected order
non_equivalence: Demonstrate changed cyclic neighbor order, not a global novelty or arbitrary state-machine inequivalence claim
K4_null_rule: If all four deterministic models contradict at least one fixed crib, reject the four models exactly; no K4 matched-null simulation or p-value required
